f1041799719ddb6d23d004cb21e8b09a9316d0c3.summary: IBM X-Force IRIS reports on ITG07, a threat actor that over nine months conducted intrusions into several geographically dispersed transportation-sector organizations. IRIS says ITG07 most closely aligns with Chafer/APT39, which Symantec describes as an alleged Iran-based group. The report describes a custom backdoor, TREKX, first reported by NCCGroup in March 2019, and tools including custom mimikatz, NBTScan, PsExec and webshells. Observed behaviour includes credential theft, lateral movement, persistence disguised as a service, and data exfiltration, which IRIS believes mainly serves…
